decisions.reason: The address autocomplete service builds on the firm's established data and web service infrastructure and costs little to run, so it fits the announced platform direction and dropping it would gain little.
The Austrian gas grid fee database extends the firm's core grid fee data business, and its upfront data-building investment argues for keeping it despite its small niche market.
Peak load window determination is a regulated, recurring calculation task close to the firm's core expertise, and it supports the process-based SaaS direction the firm has announced.
The end-customer tariff database is a product line with several models, has absorbed substantial investment and is central to the market data offer, so the firm is strongly committed to it.
Custom web services are a flexible service offering tied to the firm's integration and end-to-end platform strategy, and they need little separate upkeep.
The postal code lookup is a low-cost data utility that customers use for network operator assignment, though as a small commodity product it could be folded into other web services.
